canon: Sala de consejo modesta de los clanes: piedra apilada, vigas de leña trabada y un fuego central.
propuestas: sin banner: la forma (casa larga baja de piedra seca, techo de troncos atados y pieles, colmillos en la puerta) es la del estudio E, a falta de la decisión de diseño de la usuaria y Álvaro (regla 27)

capas.notas: IMG-54, plantilla por capas (scripts/capas.py): forma sin color en los campos de lápiz; color, paleta y luz solo en el paso a foto. Del estudio: «stacked stones» da ladrillo; la luz de dentro se pinta en la puerta salvo que el interior esté oscuro; los adornos salen pegados (menos y unidos a la estructura).
capas.sujeto: A modest council hall of a tusked steppe people standing alone on a desert plain, seen from a little above the ground three-quarters from the front, filling the middle of the image from the bottom third to near the top.
capas.tamano: It is a long low building, about three times as wide as it is tall.
capas.forma: Thick walls built like a dry-stone wall from irregular rough fieldstones of every size, without mortar, uneven and weathered, and a low gabled roof of heavy split logs laid crosswise and lashed with thick tendon cords, partly covered with sewn hides. A single wide doorway opens in the front wall, framed by two great curved bone tusks set into the ground as tall as the door; the doorway is in deep shadow inside, with only a faint glow from a fire far at the back of the hall; a thin column of smoke rises from a hole in the roof ridge.
capas.entorno: Dust has piled in a low drift along the walls. The ground is cracked earth with sparse dry tufts; flat-topped mesas fade into haze on the far horizon.
capas.color: The fieldstones are red and ochre; the logs grey-brown and weathered; the hides patched red-brown and tan. The tusks are old yellowed bone, cracked and dirty. The glow deep inside is warm orange. The ground is red earth with straw-yellow tufts, the mesas red.
capas.paleta: rust red, ochre and weathered grey-brown
capas.luz: Clear warm daylight from high on the right, short shadows to the left.
